caption: The image depicts a rectangular plate with rounded corners, decorated with intricate designs. The outer rim of the plate is adorned with a repeating pattern of large leaves and flowers, and is bordered by a geometric motif along the edge. The center of the plate features an oval frame enclosing a classical scene: a domed structure with three columns stands prominently on a rocky, grassy landscape with waves crashing in the foreground and mountainous terrain in the background. Two human figures stand on either side of the structure. The oval is bordered with a decorative bead-like edge, and the word "GEORGIA" is inscribed at the bottom center of the inner frame. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray, indicating that the image is either a monochrome print or a photograph of a black-and-white ceramic piece.
title: Platter - "Georgia Arms"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
